Package persist.lint.query.spi

package persist.lint.query.spi
Service Provider Interface (SPI) for build-time JPQL query validation.

This package defines the core abstractions used to parse and validate named JPQL queries at build time, without requiring a live database connection:

  • QueryParser — parses and semantically validates a single JPQL query string against the project's entity metamodel.
  • QueryParserFactory — factory for creating QueryParser instances; implementations are discovered at runtime via the ServiceLoader mechanism.

Provider implementations for specific JPA namespaces are shipped in separate modules (e.g. lint-persistence-jakarta and lint-persistence-legacy).
